name: Twice-Risen
description: a brimstone demon of the Cracked Road: a hunched body of cracked black basalt with molten orange light glowing through every seam, short curved horns of charred stone, small burning ember eyes, a wide jaw with a furnace glow inside, broken and patched back together twice over with cooled lava and iron staples, both horns snapped, a mismatched glowing eye

poses.stand: standing hunched, cracks stapled and patched, glaring
poses.struck: just hit and recoiling, eyes wide, mouth open, body jolted back, sparks and chips flying off it
poses.dead: breaking apart in a burst of black soot, grey ash and orange embers

idle.action: breathes and shifts its weight in place, its glow pulsing slowly

move.action: lurches forward stiffly, staples creaking, staying in the same spot in the frame

attack.action: rears back and breathes a short fan of fire forward to the right

hurt.action: is struck, jerks backward with a pained grimace, then recovers

die.action: flares bright and breaks apart into soot, ash and embers
